ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Lease renewal, Terms discussed and later stages need Annual rent and Inside security of tenure.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Upcoming", 1, "Tenant contacted", 2, "Terms discussed", 3, "Renewal agreed", 4, "Renewed", 5, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(Annual_rent__c), NOT(Security_of_tenure__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Annual rent and Inside security of tenure before moving to Terms discussed.
